title: 21. Projects: E-Commerce Platform (capstone design)
summary: Design and implement key components of a scalable e-commerce platform like Amazon/Flipkart.
objectives: Build the E-Commerce Platform (capstone design) projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body:
Design and implement key components of a scalable e-commerce platform like Amazon/Flipkart.

**You will build:**

1. Product Catalog Service with search
2. Shopping Cart & Checkout System
3. Order Processing Pipeline (using message queues)
4. Inventory Management with concurrency control
5. Data Pipeline for analytics (PySpark)
